description: Sex as recorded by the source. 'all' is the total, not a third category.
Five-year age bands with an open-ended top band.
Self-reported ability to read and write, for the population aged 5 and over. Members are exhaustive and disjoint, so they sum to the 5-plus population.

Whether population is resident in a household or in an institution such as a barracks, hostel, prison or hospital. NSO reports institutional population only at district level, and it belongs to no local unit.

A contesting political party in a Nepali election, keyed by the Election Commission's own symbol id. 'independent' is a fixed member for non-partisan FPTP winners, who have no party list and so no PR entry.
